item.title: Week 34: Getting Started and My First RAG Chatbot
item.description: Course kickoff, setting up this portfolio with Hugo and Blowfish, and an introduction to Retrieval-Augmented Generation.

item.title: Week 34: Introduction to System Development
item.description: The foundations of system development: the SDLC, Royce’s 1970 paper on the waterfall model, and the Agile Manifesto.

item.title: Week 35: RAG in Practice and Coding with Agents
item.description: Building a RAG chatbot into my portfolio, automating knowledge base updates, and a first look at AI code agents.

item.title: Week 35: Scrum
item.description: The Scrum framework: roles, events, artifacts, timeboxed sprints, Definition of Done and how Scrum supports iterative and incremental development.

item.title: Week 36: Integrating an LLM API into My Own Application
item.description: Treating an LLM as an external service: prompts, structured output, error handling, and building an AI assignment-feedback app.

item.title: Week 36: Requirements Specification
item.description: Functional and non-functional requirements, user stories and INVEST, acceptance criteria, Planning Poker, story points vs. T-shirt sizes, MoSCoW and the Definition of Done.

item.title: Week 37: Spec-Driven Development and a Real-World Case
item.description: Why AI code agents need clear specifications, Peter Naur’s ‘Programming as Theory Building’, and a company case from Engestofte Gods.

item.title: Week 37: Scrum Project Kickoff
item.description: Kickoff of our Scrum project with Alpha Solutions: shared understanding, the first Product Backlog, Definition of Done, GitHub setup and the Sprint Zero debate.

item.title: Week 38: Project Start and Coworking with Agents
item.description: Kicking off the course project, and how teams of humans and AI agents can work in parallel safely using tickets, guardrails, Git worktrees and CODEOWNERS.

item.title: Week 38: Sprint Review and Sprint Planning
item.description: Our first Sprint Review and Sprint Planning with the Product Owner: demoing the increment, adapting the Product Backlog and choosing the next Sprint Goal.

item.title: Week 39: Security, Law and Ethics
item.description: Keeping keys and secrets safe when building with agents, and the legal and ethical side of AI: the EU AI Act, transparency, copyright in RAG and sustainability.

item.title: Week 39: Reflecting on Our Scrum Practice
item.description: Second Sprint Review and Planning, and a deeper look at how we work: retrospectives, velocity, the Scrum board, backlogs, pull requests, acceptance criteria and sprint goals.

item.title: Week 40: Quality Assurance and Testing
item.description: Quality assurance in a Scrum project: the test pyramid, test strategy, what to automate, test case design techniques, testability and quality as a continuous part of the sprint.

item.title: Implementing a RAG Chatbot on My Portfolio Website
